question_en: Which are the large CRs touching many clauses? List CRs affecting five or more sections of TS 38.214.

semantic_evidence.finding: The question asks to list CR documents meeting a numeric threshold, so tdocNumber is the required document-identity role. It does not ask to report each affectedCount, clause list, title, source company, status or actual edition. Those may be optional evidence rather than extra required fields.
semantic_evidence.original_quote: Which are the large CRs touching many clauses? List CRs affecting five or more sections of TS 38.214.
query_clauses: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec {specNumber:'38.214'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL
WITH cr, reduce(clean='', i IN range(0,size(cr.clausesAffected)-1) |
clean + CASE WHEN substring(cr.clausesAffected,i,1) =~ '[0-9A-Za-z.]'
THEN substring(cr.clausesAffected,i,1) ELSE ' ' END) AS clean
WITH cr, [token IN split(clean,' ') WHERE token =~ '[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)*[A-Za-z]?[.]?'] AS tokens
UNWIND tokens AS token
WITH cr, CASE WHEN token ENDS WITH '.' THEN substring(token,0,size(token)-1) ELSE token END AS ordinal
WITH cr, count(DISTINCT ordinal) AS affectedCount
WHERE affectedCount >= 5
RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber
